_comment: Single trace-derived cloneu route using a brown pudding. The black pudding replay reached cloneu but its later metal hit entered rustm(mhitm.c:1278), whose AD_RUST branch draws rn2(1) and diverged. Brown pudding has AD_DCAY, avoiding that rust branch while retaining the metal-hit split condition at uhitm.c:4091-4104. The recipe ends at the first post-hit input boundary.
